summary.text: Daniele Monroe-Moreno is a Democratic Nevada Assemblymember for District 1 in Clark County, first elected in November 2016. The legislature lists her as chair of the Assembly Jobs and Economy Committee and as a retired corrections officer.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says Monroe-Moreno was born in Tucson, Arizona, in 1964 and lists her occupation as corrections officer, retired.
Her page lists service as second vice chair of the Clark County Democratic Party from 2013 to 2015 and as a member and mentor of the North Las Vegas Community Courts Program since 2014.
She began serving in the Nevada Assembly in 2017 after being elected in November 2016.
Her page lists her as chair of the Ways and Means Committee in the 2023 and 2025 sessions, and as chair of the Growth and Infrastructure Committee in the 2019 and 2021 sessions.
For the 2025-2026 interim, it lists her as chair of the Retirement and Benefits committee and vice chair of the Finance committee.
